mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, package_id, product_type, product_id
mapper.select: SELECT wbwr.id, wbwr.quantity in_quantity, wbwr.quantity - wbwr.package_quantity - wbwr.cargo_quantity + a.quantity un_package_quantity, a.quantity package_quantity, b.project_id, wbwr.workshop_id 'workshopInf.id', wbwr.workshop_id 'workshop.id', wbwr.warehouse_type, a.id link_id, b.monomer_id, b.area_id, a.product_type, a.product_id, b.name, b.serial_number, b.specification, b.length, b.material, b.quantity, b.net_weight, b.net_weight * a.quantity total_net_weight, b.gross_weight, b.gross_weight * a.quantity total_gross_weight, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`id` 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pd.`id` 'area.id', pd.`name` 'area.name', mbf.`id` 'factory.id', mbf.`name` 'factory.name', a.warehouse_type, a.create_user_names FROM mes_building_package_link a LEFT JOIN tech_artifact b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON b.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON b.monomer_id = pm.id AND pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON b.area_id = pd.id AND pd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_summary wbwr ON a.warehouse_record_id = wbwr.id AND wbwr.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory mbf ON wbwr.factory_id = mbf.id AND mbf.bool_delete_enum = FALSE where a.package_id = #{packageId} and a.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT wbwr.id, wbwr.warehouse_type, wbwr.quantity in_quantity, wbwr.quantity - wbwr.package_quantity - wbwr.cargo_quantity + a.quantity un_package_quantity, a.quantity package_quantity, b.project_id, a.id link_id, a.product_type, a.product_id, b.category, b.name, b.serial_number, b.plate, b.color, b.material, b.weight, b.thickness, b.width, b.length, b.quantity, a.quantity * b.length as total_length, a.quantity * b.surface_area as total_area, b.surface_area, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pd.`id` 'area.id', pd.`name` 'area.name', mbf.`id` 'factory.id', mbf.`name` 'factory.name', a.create_user_names FROM mes_building_package_link a LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON b.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN enclosure_plan pd ON b.enclosure_plan_id = pd.id AND pd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_summary wbwr ON a.warehouse_record_id = wbwr.id AND wbwr.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory mbf ON wbwr.factory_id = mbf.id AND mbf.bool_delete_enum = FALSE where a.package_id = #{packageId} and a.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ENCLOSURE.getType()} and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT wbwr.id, wbwr.warehouse_type, wbwr.quantity in_quantity, wbwr.quantity - wbwr.package_quantity - wbwr.cargo_quantity + a.quantity un_package_quantity, a.quantity package_quantity, a.id AS link_id, a.product_type, a.product_id, b.specification, b.name, b.serial_number, b.measure_unit, b.quantity, case when wbwr.outbound_detail_id is not null then CONVERT(IFNULL(wmod.mete, 0) / b.quantity, DECIMAL(18,4)) * a.quantity else CONVERT(IFNULL(b.mete, 0) / b.quantity, DECIMAL(18,4)) * a.quantity end package_mete, IFNULL(b.mete, 0) mete, b.accounting_unit, b.remark, b.user_id, b.use_property, b.business_id, b.print_quantity, b.print_time, cp.id 'project.id', cp.NAME 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`id` 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pd.`id` 'area.name', pd.`name` 'area.name', a.create_user_names FROM mes_building_package_link a LEFT JOIN tech_standard_part b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON b.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON b.monomer_id = pm.id AND pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON b.area_id = pd.id AND pd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_summary wbwr ON a.warehouse_record_id = wbwr.id AND wbwr.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN wms_move_outbound_detail wmod ON wbwr.outbound_detail_id = wmod.id AND wmod.bool_delete_enum = FALSE where a.package_id = #{packageId} and a.product_type = 8 and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT wbwr.id, wbwr.quantity in_quantity, wbwr.quantity - wbwr.package_quantity - wbwr.cargo_quantity + a.quantity un_package_quantity, a.quantity package_quantity, b.project_id, a.id link_id, wbwr.workshop_id 'workshop.id', b.monomer_id, b.area_id, a.product_type, a.product_id, b.name, b.serial_number, b.specification, b.length, b.material, b.quantity, b.net_weight, b.net_weight * a.quantity total_net_weight, b.gross_weight, b.net_weight * a.quantity total_gross_weight, b.bool_all_part_send_directly, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`id` 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pd.`id` 'area.id', pd.`name` 'area.name', mbf.`id` 'factory.id', mbf.`name` 'factory.name', a.create_user_names FROM mes_building_package_link a LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND b.relation_type in (2,16) LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON b.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON b.monomer_id = pm.id AND pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON b.area_id = pd.id AND pd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_summary wbwr ON a.warehouse_record_id = wbwr.id AND wbwr.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory mbf ON wbwr.factory_id = mbf.id AND mbf.bool_delete_enum = FALSE where a.package_id = #{packageId} and a.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@MACHINE_PART.getType()} and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT wbwr.id, wbwr.quantity in_quantity, wbwr.quantity - wbwr.package_quantity - wbwr.cargo_quantity + a.quantity un_package_quantity, a.quantity package_quantity, b.project_id, wbwr.workshop_id 'workshop.id', a.id link_id, b.monomer_id, b.area_id, a.product_type, a.product_id, b.serial_number, b.specification, b.length, b.material, b.quantity, b.net_weight, b.net_weight * a.quantity total_net_weight, b.bool_all_part_send_directly, b.name, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`id` 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pd.`id` 'area.id', pd.`name` 'area.name', mbf.`id` 'factory.id', mbf.`name` 'factory.name', a.create_user_names FROM mes_building_package_link a LEFT JOIN tech_assemble b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON b.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON b.monomer_id = pm.id AND pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON b.area_id = pd.id AND pd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_summary wbwr ON a.warehouse_record_id = wbwr.id AND wbwr.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory mbf ON wbwr.factory_id = mbf.id AND mbf.bool_delete_enum = FALSE where a.package_id = #{packageId} and a.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ASSEMBLE.getType()} and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

select.if:
select packageLink.workshop_id,
ROUND(IFNULL(sum(artifact.net_weight) / 1000, 0), 3) AS totalMete
ROUND(IFNULL(sum(artifact.gross_weight) / 1000, 0), 3) AS totalMete
from mes_building_package_number_link numberLink LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact on numberLink.product_id = artifact.id INNER JOIN mes_building_package_link packageLink on numberLink.package_link_id = packageLink.id and packageLink.product_type = 2 and packageLink.bool_delete_enum = 0
and packageLink.project_id = #{projectId}
and packageLink.workshop_id in
#{workShopId}
where numberLink.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND numberLink.in_year_month_day_date = date_format(#{dateTime}, '%Y-%m-%d')
group by packageLink.workshop_id

select packageLink.workshop_id,
sum(artifact.net_weight * packageLink.quantity) / 1000 AS totalMete
sum(artifact.gross_weight * packageLink.quantity) / 1000 AS totalMete
from mes_building_package_link packageLink LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact on packageLink.product_id = artifact.id where packageLink.bool_delete_enum = 0 and packageLink.product_type = 2 and packageLink.bool_delete_enum = 0
and packageLink.project_id = #{projectId}
and packageLink.workshop_id in
#{workShopId}
group by packageLink.workshop_id

mapper.select:
select monomer.name AS 'monomer.name', project.name AS 'project.name', project.short_name AS 'project.shortName', numberLink.product_id, artifact.name, artifact.serial_number, artifact.specification, artifact.length, artifact.material, artifact.net_weight, artifact.gross_weight, COUNT(numberLink.product_id) AS quantity, sum(artifact.net_weight) / 1000 AS totalNetWeight, sum(artifact.gross_weight) / 1000 AS totalGrossWeight from mes_building_package_number_link numberLink LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact on numberLink.product_id = artifact.id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer monomer on artifact.monomer_id = monomer.id LEFT JOIN contract_project project on artifact.project_id = project.id INNER JOIN mes_building_package_link packageLink on numberLink.package_link_id = packageLink.id and packageLink.product_type = 2 and packageLink.bool_delete_enum = 0
and packageLink.project_id = #{projectId}
and packageLink.workshop_id in
#{workShopId}
where numberLink.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND date_format(numberLink.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(#{dateTime}, '%Y-%m-%d')
group by numberLink.product_id,monomer.name
